text: Assumption: From the classification of ConnectionStateHandler as thread-safe, it is deduced that the callback is called upon connection changes in concurrent threads of the logging runtime — is this correct?

assumption: From the classification of ConnectionStateHandler as thread-safe, it is deduced that the callback is called upon connection changes in concurrent threads of the logging runtime.
rationale: SWS_LOG_00265 specifies thread safety for the type alias, whereas SWS_LOG_00205 is declared as not thread-safe for the registration function itself.
